author: Fouled
body:
Hello,

As a high demand on new YML components for the upcoming tournament, we've notified the developers of some features that we wish to be added. Lately, scoreboxes have been pushed and are now available to use in YML. The following code for it is:

triggers:
  score:
    amount:

 The code would have to be inserted into the region flag "enter".
For example, a proper coding of the scoreboxes in a region would be:

bluescore:
    type: cuboid
    min: 18,128,-719
    max: 16,130,-711
    flags:
      enter:
        who: 'blue'
        allow: true
        triggers:
      score:
        amount: 2 
          teleport:
            to: 17.5,132,-714,180,0 (spawn coords)
          sound:
            sound: PORTAL_TRAVEL
            volume: 0.7
            pitch: 2.0

The "teleport to" code makes it so if you enter the scorebox area, it teleports you back to spawn after you've gotten the points. In your code, you should have that in order to avoid getting constant points.

replies.author: Zedther
replies.body:
Fairly certain jump pads are still supported, as seen in maps like Axis.
The line of YAML for jump pads goes like this... 

jump-1-colour:
    type: point
    point: x,y,z
    flags:
      enter:
        who: '*'
        triggers:
          push:
            velocity: *.*
            vertical: *.*
